definitions.title: Centroid of a Planar Region
definitions.statement: The center of mass (centroid) of a thin homogeneous planar lamina bounded by y = f(x) and y = g(x) is given by the ratio of moments to total area A.
definitions.explanation: M_y measures tendency to rotate about y-axis; M_x measures tendency to rotate about x-axis.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Centroid coordinates are the average x and y positions weighted by area.

definitions.title: Theorem of Pappus for Volume of Revolution
definitions.statement: The volume of a solid generated by revolving a planar region of area A about an external coplanar axis equals the product of A and the distance 2pi r traveled by the region's centroid.
conditions: Axis does not cross the interior of the region
definitions.explanation: Provides an instantaneous geometric bridge between centroids and volumes of revolution.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Volume = Area times centroid travel distance.
